---
name: go-endpoint
description: Implement a Go backend endpoint with stable contracts, security, persistence, observability, and tests.
agent: Gustavo
---

Using `Gustavo` and the repository's actual Go stack, implement the HTTP or RPC endpoint with stable contracts, validation, authentication and authorization, bounded transactions and queries, safe error mapping and observability, `context.Context` propagation, migrations when needed, focused tests, `gofmt`, and existing build tooling.
